# ysdf2 — generated yclass shape classes of the v2 ydraw client interface.
#
# EVERYTHING in this directory except CMakeLists.txt and README.md is
# GENERATED by src/yetty/ysdf/gen-sdf-code.py from sdf-drawables.yaml —
# never hand-edit shapes.c; change the YAML (or the generator) and re-run
#     uv run src/yetty/ysdf/gen-sdf-code.py
# shapes.c is itself an INPUT to the yclass codegen (`make codegen`), which
# parses its annotations into the api/impl glue and model.yaml.
#
# The `2` suffix is transitional (epic #712) — see ydrawlist2/README.md.

add_library(yetty_api_ysdf2 STATIC
    ${YETTY_ROOT}/src/yetty/gen/api/ysdf2/shapes.c
)

target_include_directories(yetty_api_ysdf2 PUBLIC
    ${YETTY_ROOT}/include
)

target_link_libraries(yetty_api_ysdf2 PUBLIC
    yetty_ycore
    yetty_yclass
)

add_library(yetty_ysdf2 STATIC
    shapes.c
)

target_include_directories(yetty_ysdf2 PUBLIC
    ${YETTY_ROOT}/include
)
# shapes.c #includes its generated impl glue and the ydrawlist2 impl header
# (shape slice) via "yetty/gen/...".
target_include_directories(yetty_ysdf2 PRIVATE ${YETTY_ROOT}/src)

target_link_libraries(yetty_ysdf2 PUBLIC
    yetty_api_ysdf2
    yetty_ydrawlist2 # parent classes + the shape-slice accessor
    yetty_ycore
    yetty_yclass
    yetty_ydraw_list
)

# The generated source carries `[[clang::annotate(...)]]` (C23 attribute
# syntax).
if(NOT MSVC)
    set_target_properties(yetty_ysdf2 PROPERTIES
        C_STANDARD 23
        C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    )
endif()

# Register with the yclass codegen graph.
yetty_yclass_module(ysdf2)
